newsitem.title: USA: U.S. reserve assets fell to $65.872 bln in March.
newsitem.headline: U.S. reserve assets fell to $65.872 bln in March.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Wednesday that U.S. reserve assets fell $1.35 billion in April to $65.872 billion from $67.222 billion in March.
The department said U.S. holdings of foreign currencies were down to $31.436 billion in April from $32.447 billion in March.
Gold stock totaled $11.05 billion in both months.
Special Drawing Rights with the International Monetary Fund fell to $9.726 billion in April from $9.879 billion.
The value of the U.S. reserve position with the IMF fell to $13.66 billion in April from $13.846 billion in March.
